scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.migrate:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset --force
